articles.summary: Sepsis and septic shock are prevalent and life-threatening complications in burn patients. Despite their severity, existing diagnostic methods are limited. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy of Complete Blood Count (CBC) and CBC ratio markers in diagnosing sepsis and septic shock, and in predicting mortality among burn patients. articles.title: AFR investigating fire at apartment complex in NE Albuquerque
articles.author: Amari Saxton
articles.summary: AFR is currently investigating a fire at an apartment complex in NE Albuquerque. At approximately 6:55 p.m. on Monday, crews were driving past Mission Hill Apartments located at 1000 Menaul NE when they observed heavy smoke coming from the apartment building. The first unit arrived on scene and reported a working fire coming from the roof and third floor of the three-story building. Damage to the structure was able to be contained mostly to the roof and the apartment below. It was brought under control within 20 minutes of crews' arrival. No injuries of civilians or firefighters were reported. Crews say two apartments were affected and the occupants were assisted by Red Cross, management, and family. The cause and origin of the fire is still under investigation during this time.
